about: Big cultural and golf moments the content plan builds around (John, 19 Nov 2026: plan ahead for GTA VI, Avengers: Doomsday, Christmas and the like). The monthly moments planner (Claude) keeps this list 90 days ahead, verifies every date, and drafts tie-in posts into data/content-queue.json. Original design only: never a film's, game's or brand's logo, artwork, characters or lettering. Each moment also gets a 'look': the moment's visual language (palette, motifs, layout, type mood) translated into original art the engine can render (scripts/agent_cine.py LOOKS: vice, christmas, hero, major, night, or a custom look).
